turns.prompt: when I end a meeting, the recap leaves out any task that has a person on it but no deadline. like if they say 'Priya will send the contract' with no date it just isnt in the action items. can you fix it

I wasn't able to reproduce this, so I haven't changed any code yet. Here's what I checked.

**No code removes dateless tasks.** I followed what happens when you end a meeting, from `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts` through `generateMeetingSummary` and `processResponse` in `electron/LLMHelper.ts`, then the database, and finally the meeting page (`src/components/MeetingDetails.tsx`). Nothing along that path filters action items by owner or date. Whatever the model returns is saved and shown as-is.

**So the model itself is probably leaving them out.** Many prompts in `electron/llm/prompts.ts` include the line "Keep every action item that has an owner, even if it has no due date." But the three prompts actually used when you end a meeting don't have that rule:

- **Default recap prompt** (`MeetingPersistence.ts:194-203`): only asks for "specific next steps, assigned tasks…" and says nothing about dates.
- **Groq recap prompt** (`prompts.ts:370-393`): the only example it gives is `"Bob: Draft invite copy by Wednesday"`. That nudges the model to include only tasks that come with a deadline. This is my top suspect.
- **Mode-based recap prompt** (`MeetingPersistence.ts:175-189`): used when a mode like Team Meeting is active. It doesn't mention action items at all; they only show up if the mode has a section for them.

The likely fix is to add the "keep owner-only items, mark them 'no date given'" rule to all three, and add a dateless example to the Groq prompt. I haven't seen the bug actually happen, though. Running the real recap needs the Electron app, a live meeting and your API keys, and I didn't send a test transcript to your provider without asking.
